key: GLAMEOW: Glaaaaaa...
en: GLAMEOW: Glaaaaaa...
ja: ニャルマー: ニャアァァ……

key: GLAMEOW: ...meow?
en: GLAMEOW: ...meow?
ja: ニャルマー: ……ニャア?

key: Would you like to take Glameow with you?
en: Would you like to take Glameow with you?
ja: ニャルマーを連れて行きますか?

key: Well, hey there, darlin'.
en: Well, hey there, darlin'.
ja: あら、いらっしゃい、可愛い子。

key: My, you DO have some gorgeous Pokémon.
en: My, you DO have some gorgeous Pokémon.
ja: まあ、本当に素敵なポケモンをお持ちだこと。

key: \GHowever, I could make one even better for just $2000. Whaddya say?
en: \GHowever, I could make one even better for just $2000. Whaddya say?
ja: \Gでも、$2000でもっと素敵にしてあげられるわよ。どうかしら?

key: Awh, what's the matter, change your mind?
en: Awh, what's the matter, change your mind?
ja: あら、どうしたの、気が変わった?

key: Okie dokie. You just hold on for a little second.
en: Okie dokie. You just hold on for a little second.
ja: オッケー。ちょっとだけ待っててね。

key: All done! Here you go, sugarplum.
en: All done! Here you go, sugarplum.
ja: はい、できあがり! どうぞ、可愛い子。

key: You just come along any old time~
en: You just come along any old time~
ja: いつでも気軽に来てね〜

key: Hey, come back when you have the cash!
en: Hey, come back when you have the cash!
ja: お金ができたらまた来てね!

key: Awh, deary, you've gotta reconsider.
en: Awh, deary, you've gotta reconsider.
ja: あらあら、考え直しなさいな。

key: \GHowever I could make one even better for just $1400. Whaddya say?
en: \GHowever I could make one even better for just $1400. Whaddya say?
ja: \Gでも、$1400でもっと素敵にしてあげられるわよ。どうかしら?

key: Now I'lll look forward to seein' you again reallll soon, y'hear?
en: Now I'lll look forward to seein' you again reallll soon, y'hear?
ja: それじゃあ、また近いうちに会えるの、楽しみにしてるからね?

key: Welcome! To Glamazonia's Finest!
en: Welcome! To Glamazonia's Finest!
ja: いらっしゃい! グラマゾニア美容室へようこそ!

key: Unfortunately, we haven't quite been too glamourous lately... Sales have been on the decline.
en: Unfortunately, we haven't quite been too glamourous lately... Sales have been on the decline.
ja: 残念だけど、最近はあまり華やかじゃなくてね……売り上げが落ちてるのよ。

key: Everyone wants to go to that dratted Central Salon!
en: Everyone wants to go to that dratted Central Salon!
ja: みんな、あの忌々しいセントラルサロンに行きたがるんだから!

key: What is it? The service? The price?!
en: What is it? The service? The price?!
ja: 何なの? 接客? 値段?!

key: I must know... You!
en: I must know... You!
ja: 知らなきゃ気が済まないわ……あなた!

key: Check out the other salon! Find out what they do better than us and report back here! Don't ask why, just go! Do it!
en: Check out the other salon! Find out what they do better than us and report back here! Don't ask why, just go! Do it!
ja: あっちのサロンを見てきて! うちより何が優れてるのか調べて、ここに報告に来て! 理由なんて聞かないで、とにかく行くのよ! さあ!

key: You!
en: You!
ja: あなた!

key: What did you find out? Is it the products? The staff?
en: What did you find out? Is it the products? The staff?
ja: 何がわかった? 商品? それともスタッフ?

key: Hm? They only charge $1500?!
en: Hm? They only charge $1500?!
ja: え? 向こうは$1500しか取ってないですって?!

key: Well, that's obviously it! We'll undersell them and make a comeback!
en: Well, that's obviously it! We'll undersell them and make a comeback!
ja: それに決まってるじゃない! うちはもっと安くして、巻き返すわよ!

key: Thank you, thank you~ As a token of our appreciation, feel free to take one of Glamazonia's signature mascot Pokémon! They make great pets!
en: Thank you, thank you~ As a token of our appreciation, feel free to take one of Glamazonia's signature mascot Pokémon! They make great pets!
ja: ありがとう、本当にありがとう〜 感謝のしるしに、グラマゾニア看板ポケモンを一匹持って行っていいわよ! きっと素敵なペットになるはず!

key: And great advertising...
en: And great advertising...
ja: それに、いい宣伝にもなるし……

key: What? Oh, nothing! Have a good day!
en: What? Oh, nothing! Have a good day!
ja: え? ああ、何でもないわ! それじゃ、良い一日を!

key: Welcome! To Glamazonia's finest!
en: Welcome! To Glamazonia's finest!
ja: いらっしゃい! グラマゾニア美容室へようこそ!

key: With business on the rise again, we're looking to hire more fabulous dressers!
en: With business on the rise again, we're looking to hire more fabulous dressers!
ja: 商売もまた上向いてきたから、もっと素敵なスタイリストを募集してるのよ!

key: If you love to make Pokémon sparkle and shine, please take an application from the table behind me!
en: If you love to make Pokémon sparkle and shine, please take an application from the table behind me!
ja: ポケモンをキラキラに輝かせるのが好きなら、後ろのテーブルから応募用紙を取ってね!

key: A stack of job applications for Glamazonia Salon sits on the table.
en: A stack of job applications for Glamazonia Salon sits on the table.
ja: テーブルの上には、グラマゾニアサロンの求人応募用紙が積まれている。

key: Take one?
en: Take one?
ja: 一枚もらう?

key: Say, Trainer, you lookin' to get a Furfrou trimmed up?
en: Say, Trainer, you lookin' to get a Furfrou trimmed up?
ja: ねえトレーナーさん、トリミアンのカットに興味ある?

key: We offer Furfrou grooming at a special rate here. Feel free to bring one in at any time!
en: We offer Furfrou grooming at a special rate here.  Feel free to bring one in at any time!
ja: ここではトリミアンのグルーミングを特別料金でご提供してるの。いつでも気軽に連れてきてね!

key: We put a lot of love into working with our precious poodles.
en: We put a lot of love into working with our precious poodles.
ja: この可愛いプードルたちには、たっぷり愛情をこめてお世話してるのよ。

key: Unfortunately, not too many people seem to be interested in the poor fellows...
en: Unfortunately, not too many people seem to be interested in the poor fellows...
ja: 残念だけど、この子たちに興味を持ってくれる人はあまりいなくて……

key: Oh, that's... quite the interesting Furfrou you've got there.
en: Oh, that's... quite the interesting Furfrou you've got there.
ja: あら、それは……なかなか個性的なトリミアンね。

key: But don't you worry, we aren't the best in the business for nothing!
en: But don't you worry, we aren't the best in the business for nothing!
ja: でも心配しないで、だてにこの業界一とは言ってないんだから!

key: I'll make sure that this darling of yours looks as gorgeous as it gets.
en: I'll make sure that this darling of yours looks as gorgeous as it gets.
ja: この子を、これ以上ないくらい素敵に仕上げてみせるわ。

key: Now, our styling services are $2000 a pop. Is that all right?
en: Now, our styling services are $2000 a pop. Is that all right?
ja: うちのスタイリングは一回$2000。それで大丈夫?

key: Oh, sugar. You've got a big heart to spend what little you've got on this Pokémon.
en: Oh, sugar. You've got a big heart to spend what little you've got on this Pokémon.
ja: あら、あなた。少ないお金をこのポケモンのために使うなんて、心が大きいのね。

key: But I'm afraid I can't do it for that much.
en: But I'm afraid I can't do it for that much.
ja: でも、悪いけどそれじゃできないわ。

key: Come back after you pull in some cash, all right?
en: Come back after you pull in some cash, all right?
ja: お金を貯めてからまた来てね、いい?

key: Just give me a moment then...
en: Just give me a moment then...
ja: それじゃ、ちょっと待っててね……

key: And we're done!
en: And we're done!
ja: はい、終わり!

key: I'd say that's quite the look!
en: I'd say that's quite the look!
ja: なかなかの仕上がりだと思わない?

key: Bring it back around any time now, you hear?
en: Bring it back around any time now, you hear?
ja: またいつでも連れてきてね?

key: You've got the darling! Wonderful!
en: You've got the darling! Wonderful!
ja: この子を持ってるのね! 素晴らしいわ!

key: I know it may seem expensive, but believe me--
en: I know it may seem expensive, but believe me--
ja: 高く感じるかもしれないけど、信じて――

key: We use all natural styling products that are guaranteed to keep the look in ship-shape for weeks on end.
en: We use all natural styling products that are guaranteed to keep the look in ship-shape for weeks on end.
ja: うちは天然由来のスタイリング製品だけを使っていて、何週間もその仕上がりをキープできる保証つきなの。

key: Other regions' cuts may grow out after a few days, but not ours!
en: Other regions' cuts may grow out after a few days, but not ours!
ja: 他の地方のカットは数日で伸びちゃうかもしれないけど、うちのは違うわ!

key: At Glamazonia, you get the very best-- and it's there to stay.
en: At Glamazonia, you get the very best-- and it's there to stay.
ja: グラマゾニアなら、最高のものが手に入る――しかもずっと続くのよ。

key: Of course, you could always change it later here if you like.
en: Of course, you could always change it later here if you like.
ja: もちろん、気が変わったらいつでもここで変えられるわ。

key: So, what kind of style are you thinking?
en: So, what kind of style are you thinking?
ja: それで、どんなスタイルにする?

key: \ch[385,-\n \n1,Normal,Star,Heart,Pharaoh,Matron,Dandy,Kabuki, La Reine,Debutante,Diamond]
en: \ch[385,-\n \n1,Normal,Star,Heart,Pharaoh,Matron,Dandy,Kabuki, La Reine,Debutante,Diamond]
ja: \ch[385,-\n \n1,ノーマル,スターカット,ハートカット,キングダムカット,マダムカット,ジェントルカット,カブキカット, クイーンカット,レディカット,ダイヤカット]

key: Huh, you just want it back to the normal shaggy look?
en: Huh, you just want it back to the normal shaggy look?
ja: あら、普通のもふもふスタイルに戻したいの?

key: Well all right...
en: Well all right...
ja: まあ、いいわ……

key: Now you just hold right on...
en: Now you just hold right on...
ja: ちょっとだけ待っててね……

key: I guess there's something to be said for going au naturale.
en: I guess there's something to be said for going au naturale.
ja: ノーマルにするのも、悪くないわよね。

key: Star fashion, huh? It'll be dazzling!
en: Star fashion, huh? It'll be dazzling!
ja: スタースタイルね? まばゆく仕上げてみせるわ!

key: Your starshine is set to sparkle!
en: Your starshine is set to sparkle!
ja: あなたの星、キラキラに輝く準備ができたわよ!

key: Heart fashion is it? I'll have it done in a beat!
en: Heart fashion is it? I'll have it done in a beat!
ja: ハートスタイルね? あっという間に仕上げてみせる!

key: Be warned-- The hearts you see on it aren't the only ones around, as this Pokémon is sure to steal some!
en: Be warned-- The hearts you see on it aren't the only ones around, as this Pokémon is sure to steal some!
ja: 言っておくけど――見えてるハートだけじゃないわよ。このポケモン、きっと誰かのハートも盗んじゃうんだから!

key: Pharoah fashion, huh? Okay, we can make this one rule.
en: Pharoah fashion, huh? Okay, we can make this one rule.
ja: キングダムカットね? よし、これで君臨できるようにしてあげる。

key: This leader's on the leading edge of aesthetics now!
en: This leader's on the leading edge of aesthetics now!
ja: このリーダー、美の最先端を行くことになるわね!

key: A Matron fashion? One bonne bonnet coming right up!
en: A Matron fashion? One bonne bonnet coming right up!
ja: マダムスタイルね? 素敵な帽子、すぐに仕上げるわ!

key: Watch out world, it's a matriarchy now!
en: Watch out world, it's a matriarchy now!
ja: 世界よ気をつけなさい、女帝の時代の到来よ!

key: Dandy fashion, is it? Hats off for that one!
en: Dandy fashion, is it? Hats off for that one!
ja: ダンディスタイルね? それは脱帽ものだわ!

key: I'd say it suits it all too well!
en: I'd say it suits it all too well!
ja: 似合いすぎるくらい似合ってるわね!

key: Kabuki fashion? That'll be entertaining!
en: Kabuki fashion? That'll be entertaining!
ja: カブキカット? それは見ものになりそうね!

key: I'd say we've really unmasked this Pokémon's beauty!
en: I'd say we've really unmasked this Pokémon's beauty!
ja: このポケモンの美しさ、しっかり引き出してみせたわよ!

key: La Reine fashion? We'll rain beauty down on 'em!
en: La Reine fashion? We'll rain beauty down on 'em!
ja: 女王スタイルね? 美しさの雨を降らせてあげる!

key: The francais funk is finally finished!
en: The francais funk is finally finished!
ja: フランス仕込みの粋なスタイル、ついに完成よ!

key: Debutante fashion, is it? We'll fill it to the brim with beauty!
en: Debutante fashion, is it? We'll fill it to the brim with beauty!
ja: レディカットね? 美しさをたっぷり詰め込んであげる!

key: This Pokémon's sure to debut with delight!
en: This Pokémon's sure to debut with delight!
ja: このポケモン、華々しくデビューすること間違いなしね!

key: Diamond fashion, is it? I guess this is what you call a diamond in the ruff!
en: Diamond fashion, is it? I guess this is what you call a diamond in the ruff!
ja: ダイヤスタイルね? まさに『粗削りのダイヤ』ってやつね!

key: This Pokémon's now set to shine as both man's and a girl's best friend!
en: This Pokémon's now set to shine as both man's and a girl's best friend!
ja: このポケモン、男の親友にも、女の子の親友にもなる輝きを手に入れたわね!

key: What's the matter? Did you change your mind?
en: What's the matter? Did you change your mind?
ja: どうしたの? 気が変わった?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
